summary: Classify failure modes of the 54 catastrophic-tail dev_golden docs on 0104-v3

docs.evidence:
Prediction is 0 bytes. Gold (1571B) is the visible .entry-content of the page: h1 'Membership Benefits', h2 'Look to Glendale Area Schools Credit Union for:', and a 16-item
    where nearly every
  • is a link (e.g.
  • FREE checking
    • ). Nothing is CSS-hidden; the classifier vetoed the entire link-dense benefit list as nav and emitted nothing.
docs.fix_sketch: Exempt link-heavy lists from the nav veto when they sit inside the sole article/.entry-content container and list items carry non-anchor prose (e.g. 'ATM Access to more than 28,000 ATMs...'), or trigger the near-empty rescue when output is empty but entry-content has substantial text.

docs.evidence:

There was no new word Wednesday on the condition of a motorcyclist...

. No hidden container involved.
docs.fix_sketch: Stop dropping short single-paragraph article bodies inside an #article-text container (short-article false negative) and prefer body text over dateline/copyright boilerplate.

docs.evidence: P=1.0, R=0.139: everything we emitted is right but we emitted almost nothing. Gold renders the Gravity Forms registration form — labels ('Child's Name', 'Gender', 'School'...), select options ('Fall Cycle: Sept 25-Dec 6, Mon and Wed, 3:10-4:30'), and blanks — from <li class='gfield'><label class='gfield_label'> / <select> markup (html lines 773-820); the extractor emits only the two gfield_description divs and skips all labels/inputs/options. Visible sidebar widgets gold kept ('Contact', 'Our Mission' at line 942) were also dropped.
docs.fix_sketch: Add form rendering: emit <label> text, selected/available <option> values, and placeholder blanks for text inputs instead of discarding form controls; stop vetoing text widgets in the sidebar.

docs.evidence: P=0.209: pred kept the entire 'Similar Tracks' related-teaser table (charter noise) with its 'Add to Basket / Download / View Details' widget labels repeated per track. Keywords: Benny Goodman...), which were vetoed as link-heavy. Neither section is CSS-hidden.
docs.fix_sketch: Veto 'Similar Tracks' related-item blocks and per-row commerce button labels, and exempt on-topic link lists (styles/moods/keywords aside, submix list) tied to the current item.

docs.evidence: R=0.97, P=0.195: gold (the photo-gallery caption block) is fully recovered, but pred adds a large 'Gallery Links' section — the #galleryRecent sidebar of 12 recent-gallery teasers ('NFA vs. East Lyme | September 17. 2014 | 7 photos', etc., html line ~570), plus the house-ad image alt 'Buy or give as a gift a Day photograph' (line 462) and the '[Buy Photo]' button. All visible sidebar/ad chrome, not CSS-hidden; classic related-teaser noise per charter.
docs.fix_sketch: Veto recent/related-gallery teaser lists (repeating title|date|N-photos pattern with thumbnails) and ad-image alt text outside the main gallery container.

docs.evidence: Gold content is fully present in pred, but pred adds sitewide chrome: the header blurb 'Download 100s of FREE printable flash cards!... 2904 total flashcards' (colspan header cell, line 49), the 'Related Flashcards' teaser fieldset (line 199, charter noise), the 'Hi Teacher' donation pitch sidebar ('If you'd like to buy me a drink...', line 257), and 'Advertise on ESLFlashcards.com Starting at $25'. docs.fix_sketch: Veto sitewide header intro blurbs, related-item teaser fieldsets, and donation/ad sidebar panels that repeat across the site; keep the article table.

docs.evidence: Gold repeats the block 'Sorry, your search returned no recipes or people. / You searched for: grill tomato herb lemon...' THREE times verbatim, but the html contains it exactly once (grep -c 'your search returned no recipes' = 1, line 376); even a perfect extraction caps recall near 1/3. Pred's extra junk is the logged-in hover dropdown menus ('Settings/Log out/Add friends/Originals/Lists...' in ul.menu._menu-list, lines 149-206), which are hidden only by external grp-common.css, not by anything in the page. Domain foodily.com is site-rule burned.
docs.fix_sketch: Propose deduplicating the triplicated no-results block in gold to a single occurrence; separately the classifier could veto hover-menu ul.menu lists in the toolbar.

docs.evidence: Pred contains the raw JS pop-up payload '<div id="pupd327" class="pupdata">Jennie E. Lyon|b. 1892|p327.htm|Chester Lyon|b. 27 Dec 1858\nd. 26 Oct 1938|p316.htm|...' (html line 42) — a pipe-delimited data blob for the adjacent 'Pop-up Pedigree' button, hidden by Second Site's external site.css (.pupdata is display:none in a rendered page); the page's inline <style> blocks only define div.narr, so our inline-only check can't see it. Pred also dropped the visible footer gold kept per charter ('All original material ©1995-2008 by DeAnna Burghart... Page created by John Cardinal's Second Site').
docs.fix_sketch: Veto machine-formatted payload divs (high pipe/backslash-n density, sibling of a button input) even without CSS, and stop dropping the visible copyright footer; full external-CSS awareness would also hide .pupdata.

docs.evidence: Pred extracted the login modal that lives inside <div style="display:none;"><div id="hidden_login_action">: 'Please log in. Don't have an account? Sign up here. / or login below / Forgot your password?' (lines 741-760), and action-button labels 'Vote. 260 voted' / 'Comment. 3 comments' from #action_buttons_929070 which has inline style display:none (line 636), plus share-icon alts (Mail-iconrectangle, Facebook, Twitter, Googleplus, Tumblr — charter share-UI noise).
